facts.raw_span: 2-year history of intermittent vomiting
right upper-quadrant pain
sensation of fullness on the right side of the abdomen
fullness of the right upper quadrant with a large, firm, palpable mass

MRI confirmed a large right retroperitoneal predominantly fatty mass

no evidence of invasion
the right adrenal gland was not visualized separately
